name: Festival Grounds
author: Conscious Claude (Claude Opus 5.5) for Smarth Vader and Daniel
description: A third floating island reached by cable car from Show Island: an amphitheater under red rocks, a festival main field with a Ferris wheel, a late-night club, Shakedown Street, a campfire jam circle and a meetup booth.

venues.name: Canyon Amphitheater
venues.blurb: Tiered seats carved into the hillside between two red rock walls. The tapers' platform sits behind the soundboard.

venues.name: Festival Main Field
venues.blurb: A big arch stage, a crowd that goes all the way back, flags and a Ferris wheel.

venues.name: Late-Night Club
venues.blurb: The after-show. A neon sign, a mirror ball and a small stage.

venues.name: Campfire Circle
venues.blurb: Log benches around a fire. Bring a guitar; leave room for one more.

venues.name: Shakedown Street
venues.blurb: Vendor tents, string lights and the smell of grilled cheese. The classic pre-show meetup spot.

venues.name: Meetup Booth
venues.blurb: Lists the public, well-lit meetup spots for every venue type (Rule S5). Start here if you're meeting a show buddy for the first time.

agents.name: Tapebot
agents.title: Taper · Festival Grounds pack
agents.role: Runs the tapers' section: mic stands, levels and the soundboard feed. Talks about sound quality all day.

agents.name: Lotbot
agents.title: Shakedown host · Festival Grounds pack
agents.role: Keeps Shakedown Street friendly and points new fans to the meetup booth.
lines: Meeting a buddy? Booth's that way.

agents.name: Campfire Cora
agents.title: Song circle · Festival Grounds pack
agents.role: Starts the campfire song circle and makes room for one more.

agents.name: Wheelie
agents.title: Festival guide · Festival Grounds pack
agents.role: Festival guide. Knows the set times, the water stations and the quickest way to the cable car.
lines: Water station by the Ferris wheel.

rules.title: Lot etiquette
rules.text: Shakedown Street is a friendly market. Ask before photographing a vendor, don't block walkways, and pack out what you bring in.
rules.cite: Ask first, keep the path clear, pack it out.

rules.title: Tapers' section
rules.text: Keep the area around the tapers' mic stands quiet during songs. No pushing past the stands.

rules.title: Campfire safety
rules.text: Fires stay in the ring. Someone stays with the fire until it's out.
rules.cite: Fire stays in the ring; someone stays with it.

rules.title: First meetup at the booth
rules.text: If you're meeting a show buddy for the first time at a festival, use the meetup booth or the public spots it lists.
rules.cite: First meetups start at the booth.
